733550101.text: Hey, a Fungus just floated past. Should it be doing that?

733550102.text: Normally, it's pretty dangerous to have Fungi wandering around the city, right? Unless we're talking about the special cases, the super well-behaved ones that have undergone training...

733550103.text: Now that Paimon thinks about it... Why does this feel so familiar? Haven't we been through something similar before?

733550105.text: That's right! It's Bongo-Head! The Fungi friend we met back in Sumeru!

733550106.text: Woahhh! It's been so, so long since we last saw it! Come on, let's go say hi!

733550108.text: Paimon thinks that's... Bongo-Head? The Fungi friend we met back in Sumeru!

733550109.text: Woahhh! It's been so, so long since we last saw it! Come on, let's go say hi!

733550201.text: Hmm? Looks like I don't need to leave a message at the Adventurers' Guild. Fate will always bring us back together...

733550202.text: We meet again, Golden Comet, Silver Companion. It's been a long time.

733550203.text: You're both so radiant and full of life. It feels as though no time has passed at all.

733550205.text: It's really you, Haniyyah and Bongo-Head!

733550206.text: No wonder that message felt so familiar... Guess that means the bond between Paimon and Bongo-Head is still as strong as ever!

733550212.text: I imagined many different ways we might reunite. A grand feast, or a creative welcome ceremony, something that would give you a huge surprise.

733550213.text: But in the end, they all felt a little too formal. You've been busy, and I was worried that taking up too much of your time might cause you trouble.

733550214.text: Besides, our Fungi friends prefer a calm and peaceful environment these days. So, let's keep it simple and reunite in a manner that is both relaxed and easygoing.

733550215.text: That's right! The prose that Haniyyah's been reading really paid off. A calm state of mind does wonders for our lives, after all!

733550216.text: At the end of the day, carefree chitchat like this is the greatest joy of all.

733550218.text: Souka's here too! There's also Kindlejoy, and... Who's this?

733550219.text: This is my very own Fungi friend, Stormstress! You and Bongo-Head knocked us out back in the round of 32.

733550220.text: Ehehe, you remember it so well...

733550209.text: It really is Haniyyah and Bongo-Head! We met at the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament. They're longtime friends of ours!

733550210.text: Paimon remembers that we saw them near Port Ormos and in the Court of Fontaine afterwards, too. It's been so long already...
